title: Dashboard state
description: The dashboard surface: which platform view is active and the ordered stack of cards per view. The dashboard shows only pinned cards, newest pin last; unpinned cards live on a separate Reports page. Navigation is the platform dropdown only — there is no global date range (every card owns its own; see card.schema.json).

activePlatform.description: Persisted platform selection (localStorage key mk-dash-platform in the reference implementation).

client.description: Whose account this dashboard reports on. Rendered in the top bar as mono caps beside the wordmark.

currency.description: This system formats INR with K / L / Cr only.

views.description: Card stacks per platform view. Array order = render order (newest pin last).

cardStack.description: Full-width cards stacked vertically with a 16px gap, max page width 1440.
